items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 1:04 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed 1:06 p.m., and reconvened at 7:09 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present, with the exception of Councillor S. Stretch.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a security of property matter and a potential land disposition matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (a) and (c) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
motions.text_html: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a security of property matter and a potential land disposition matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (a) and (c) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.text: "That the modernized Human Resources policies, attached as Appendix A to Corporate Services report COR-2026-207 be approved; and further, That the redundant Human Resources policies, attached as Appendix B to Corporate Services report COR-2026-207 be repealed."

motions.item_title: Attestations Pertaining to Regulatory Functions, COR-2026-237
motions.text: "That the Director of Engineering Services, the Manager of Engineering Design and Approval, the Director of Sanitary and Stormwater Utilities, the Manager of Environmental Compliance and Utility Performance, and the Corporate Sustainability Officer be authorized to make attestations to the City’s involvement in various regulatory functions as required by Federal and Provincial Governments and other government mandated regulatory entities, as outlined in Corporate Services Department report COR-2026-237."
